journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
title: Dysregulation of microRNAs after myocardial infarction reveals a role of miR-29 in cardiac fibrosis.
reported_direction: inhibition -> collagen UP; over-expression -> collagen DOWN
evidence_note: Foundational paper: 'down-regulation of miR-29 would ... induce the expression of collagens, whereas over-expression of miR-29 in fibroblasts reduces collagen expression'

journal: Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A
title: MicroRNA 29c is down-regulated in nasopharyngeal carcinomas, up-regulating mRNAs encoding extracellular matrix proteins.
reported_direction: miR-29c LOW in tumour -> ECM mRNAs UP; restoring miR-29c represses them
evidence_note: miR-29c down-regulated in NPC, up-regulating mRNAs encoding extracellular matrix proteins

title: A MicroRNA-29 Mimic (Remlarsen) Represses Extracellular Matrix Expression and Fibroplasia in the Skin.
perturbation: intradermal miR-29 mimic, human phase-2 skin study
evidence_note: First-in-class miR-29 mimic in humans; remlarsen repressed collagen expression and development of fibroplasia in skin

title: Improved Radiotherapy Sensitivity of Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma Cells by miR-29-3p Targeting COL1A1 3'-UTR.
perturbation: mimic and inhibitor in nasopharyngeal carcinoma cells
evidence_note: COL1A1 confirmed a direct target of miR-29a; COL1A1 knockdown phenocopies miR-29a for radiosensitivity

title: miR-29 Family Inhibits Resistance to Methotrexate and Promotes Cell Apoptosis by Targeting COL3A1 and MCL1 in Osteosarcoma.
reported_direction: miR-29 over-expression -> COL3A1 mRNA and protein DOWN
evidence_note: Over-expression of miR-29 family decreased COL3A1 and MCL1 mRNA and protein; COL3A1 over-expression rescued the phenotype

title: Inhibiting collagen I production and tumor cell colonization in the lung via miR-29a-3p loading of exosome-/liposome-based nanovesicles.
reported_direction: miR-29a-3p delivery -> collagen I secretion DOWN, lung colonisation reduced
evidence_note: Clinical lung tumour data show miR-29a-3p expression negatively correlates with collagen I; delivery down-regulated collagen I secretion by lung fibroblasts in vivo

title: Extracellular Vesicles from Osteotropic Triple-Negative Breast Cancer Cells Transfer miRNAs to Bone Cells Reducing Collagen Expression and Bone Matrix Mineralisation.
perturbation: miRNA mimic transfection of osteoblasts; miRNAs carried by MDA-MB-231 breast-cancer EVs
model_system: mouse osteoblasts; MDA-MB-231 and 4T1 breast cancer EVs
reported_direction: miR-29a/29b mimic -> collagen 1a1 and 1a2 mRNA DOWN
evidence_note: Breast-cancer-derived extracellular vesicles shuttle miR-29a/b to bone cells; mimics reduced collagen1a1 and 1a2 mRNA and mineralisation

title: Decreased expression of microRNA-29 family in leiomyoma contributes to increased major fibrillar collagen production.
perturbation: over-expression and knockdown in leiomyoma / myometrial cells
readout_genes: fibrillar collagens type I, II, III
reported_direction: miR-29 knockdown -> collagen III UP; miR-29 over-expression -> fibrillar collagens DOWN
evidence_note: Down-regulation of miR-29 species in myometrium increases collagen type III; when miR-29 members are over-expressed the major fibrillar collagens decrease

title: Long Noncoding RNA MIAT Modulates the Extracellular Matrix Deposition in Leiomyomas by Sponging MiR-29 Family.
perturbation: lncRNA MIAT sponging of miR-29 family; TGF-beta3 induction
reported_direction: MIAT sequesters miR-29 -> COL1A1/COL3A1 UP; miR-29 restoration blocks induction
evidence_note: TGF-beta3 induced COL1A1, COL3A1 and MIAT; miR-29 mediates the effect on COL1A1 and COL3A1 induction

title: Genipin inhibits the scleral expression of miR-29 and MMP2 and promotes COL1A1 expression in myopic eyes of guinea pigs.
perturbation: pharmacological reduction of scleral miR-29 by genipin
evidence_note: Genipin inhibits scleral expression of miR-29 and MMP2 and promotes COL1A1 expression - reverse-direction confirmation

title: MicroRNA-29b Overexpression Decreases Extracellular Matrix mRNA and Protein Production in Human Corneal Endothelial Cells.
perturbation: over-expression in human corneal endothelial cells
reported_direction: miR-29b over-expression -> COL1A1 mRNA to 1.9% of control; protein reduced
evidence_note: Quantitative ECM reduction after miR-29b over-expression

title: MicroRNA-29a inhibits collagen expression and induces apoptosis in human fetal scleral fibroblasts by targeting the Hsp47/Smad3 signaling pathway.
reported_direction: mimic -> COL1A1 DOWN; inhibitor -> collagen production UP
evidence_note: Both directions tested in the same system

title: Regulation of type I collagen expression by microRNA-29 following ionizing radiation.
reported_direction: miR-29 targets type I collagen genes via 3'UTR binding
evidence_note: Radiation-induced type I collagen increase is miR-29 dependent

title: miR-29c is downregulated in renal interstitial fibrosis in humans and rats and restored by HIF-α activation.
model_system: rat remnant kidney, human IgA nephropathy, HK2 cells
reported_direction: miR-29c DOWN -> ECM/collagen UP; restoration attenuates fibrosis
evidence_note: The miR-29 family directly targets a large number of extracellular matrix genes
